subject: maths
question: If Asha borrows Rs. 52000 from Lakshmi for a period of four years. What will be the rate of simple interest per annum if Asha has to pay an interest of Rs. 20800 at the end of four years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 52000

Time (T) = 4 years

Simple Interest (SI) = Rs. 20800

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

Given, SI = Rs. 20800

⇒ 20800 = (52000 × R × 4) / 100

⇒ 20800 = 2080R

⇒ R = 20800 / 2080

⇒ R = 10

**The rate of simple interest per annum is 10%.**
